wikitext2_bigram_conditioning.description: Scaled reproduction target: WikiText-2 line-level language modeling with GPT-2 BPE tokens and canonicality-constrained token distributions.

relative_log_loss_to_baseline.description: Primary likelihood metric normalized by the same-slice unconstrained baseline; values below 1.0 mean better held-out fit.

log_loss_bits_per_string.description: Absolute held-out negative log likelihood in bits per scored string.

loss_improvement_bits_per_string.description: Same-slice reduction in held-out bits per string relative to the unconstrained baseline.

log_loss_bits_per_token.description: Length-normalized held-out negative log likelihood to catch gains concentrated only on long or short strings.

finite_record_rate.description: Fraction of scored records assigned finite probability, penalizing methods that improve averages by dropping hard examples from support.

canonical_sample_rate.description: Constraint metric measuring the fraction of generated samples with tokenizer-canonical token encodings.

vocab_size.description: Support-size constraint so improvements do not come solely from shrinking the reduced token vocabulary.

The primary relative_log_loss_to_baseline values are derived from that row to make the scaled n-gram reproduction comparable without rescaling or fabricating absolute losses.
